nodes.description: Private mapping of account balances in ERC20; mutated by transfer, mint and burn paths.
Private nested mapping storing ERC20 allowances owner => spender => amount.
Private total token supply, increased on mint and decreased on burn.
Token name string stored by ERC20Detailed.
Token symbol string stored by ERC20Detailed.
Token decimals value stored by ERC20Detailed.
Public ERC20 transfer; moves value from msg.sender to a recipient via _transfer.
Public ERC20 approve; sets allowance from msg.sender to spender via _approve.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; moves tokens from an owner using the caller allowance.
Increases the caller allowance for a spender using SafeMath add.
Decreases the caller allowance for a spender using SafeMath sub.
Internal balance-mutating transfer routine; requires a non-zero recipient.
Internal mint routine increasing total supply and recipient balance.
Internal burn routine decreasing total supply and account balance.
Internal allowance writer; validates owner and spender are non-zero.
Internal burn-from routine combining _burn and an allowance reduction.
Public burn of the caller own tokens.
Public burn of tokens belonging to another account using allowance.
SANIBO constructor; sets token metadata and mints the initial supply to msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, spender or mint recipient across the contract.
Direct write to _balances for both sender and recipient inside _transfer.
Direct write to _allowed allowance entry inside _approve.
Supply and balance inflation on mint; initial supply is minted to msg.sender.
Supply and balance deflation on burn without any access restriction on _burn.
Public view returning the balance of an account.
Public view returning the allowance between owner and spender.
Public view returning the current total supply.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the source account of the transfer.
to parameter flows into transfer and onward into _transfer.
value parameter flows into transfer and controls the moved amount.
transfer delegates the state mutation to the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer performs the unchecked-by-caller balance state write.
The transfer state write mutates the _balances mapping.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
spender parameter flows into approve.
value parameter flows into approve.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_approve performs the allowance state write.
The allowance write mutates the _allowed mapping.
_approve reads and writes the _allowed mapping.
from parameter selects the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter selects the credited account in transferFrom.
value parameter is the amount moved and deducted from allowance.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move balances.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the remaining allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowed to compute the remaining allowance.
spender parameter flows into increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in increaseAllowance.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance reads _allowed before increasing it.
spender parameter flows into decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the current allowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in decreaseAllowance.
decreaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance reads _allowed before decreasing it.
from parameter identifies the debited balance slot.
to parameter identifies the credited balance slot.
value parameter is the transferred amount checked by SafeMath.
msg.sender propagates as from when transfer invokes _transfer.
account parameter receives the minted balance.
value parameter is the minted amount.
_mint performs unrestricted supply and balance inflation; the constructor mints to msg.sender.
The mint operation increases _totalSupply.
_mint reads and writes _totalSupply.
_mint credits the recipient entry in _balances.
account parameter identifies the debited balance slot for burning.
value parameter is the burned amount.
_burn performs the supply and balance deflation.
The burn operation decreases _totalSupply.
_burn reads and writes _totalSupply.
_burn debits the account entry in _balances.
owner parameter is the allowance owner in _approve.
spender parameter is the allowance spender in _approve.
value parameter is written as the new allowance.
burn forwards execution to the internal _burn routine.
msg.sender is the account whose tokens are burned in burn.
value parameter is the amount burned by burn.
burnFrom forwards execution to _burnFrom.
from parameter is the account debited by burnFrom.
value parameter is the amount burned by burnFrom.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is reduced in burnFrom.
_burnFrom calls _burn to destroy the tokens.
_burnFrom calls _approve to reduce the consumed allowance.
msg.sender is read from _allowed inside _burnFrom.
The SANIBO constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
The whole initial supply is minted to the deployer msg.sender with no access control.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowed mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
